readerCopy.headline: The stakes are getting higher.
readerCopy.body:
You may be offered more influence and discover that influence comes with terms. A decision that once felt minor can suddenly affect more people, more money, or more of the future than you expected. A long effort may finally give you enough leverage to change an arrangement that used to feel fixed.

Jupiter conjunct Pluto can make power feel useful and urgent at the same time. Use any extra leverage cleanly. If the win depends on someone else having no room to say no, read the terms again. More influence is valuable when it improves the decision, not only your ability to force it.
